notable_absence.finding: Every server:-scoped xref on this page is hardcoded to Server 7.1 (e.g. '#7.1@server:learn:security/certificates.adoc') even though the registry's own extraction of these same target pages is filed under server/8.0 (the current documented version). A page whose title and content otherwise carry no version marker is silently pinned to a specific, now-superseded Server release through its cross-reference syntax alone - a version-drift risk that is invisible to a reader and only surfaces when the xref-resolution mismatch is checked mechanically, as happened here.
